hypotheses.physical_signature: Resolves four compounding blind-fault failure modes in H86F-EWCS: (1) Basin-and-Range listric/planar 45-60 deg dipping normal faults displace their 0.5-1.1 km deep Cenozoic basin density contrast (Bands 5, 11, 13, 15, 18) and smectite/brine MT plume (Band 17) horizontally into the hanging wall by 500-1100 m (5-11 px, outside the 300 m DTI kernel), so bilinear up-dip projection along +n_HW maps deep gravity/conductivity anomalies back onto the emergent footwall trace; (2) branch-cut-free spin-2 nematic structure directors (cos 2psi, sin 2psi) across Laplace gravity g_zz, Miller magnetic tilt (Bands 3, 9), RTP/TMI remanence contrast (Bands 1, 2, 14), basement depth (Band 15), 1 m LiDAR scarps, and diffused fold-visible fault strikes enforce kinematic strike alignment and Riedel R-shear relay obliquity while vetoing uncorroborated E-W airborne flight-line corrugations; (3) sub-pixel 1 m 3DEP LiDAR micro-scarps, 10 m profile curvature/fluvial chi knickpoints, Cordell compaction-stripped sub-playa horst steps, and GeoDAWN K/eTh adularia-illite metasomatic enrichment detect degraded piedmont and playa traces; and (4) 5-fold (80%->20%, 3 px buffered-component) out-of-fold PU calibration + Minoux lazy-greedy submodular 300 m triangular-kernel allocation replaces H86F-EWCS's scale-mismatched 50/50 split and pointwise Poisson-disc thinning at exact matched 37,654-dot cardinality.
hypotheses.why_blind_not_mapped: Pre-3DEP USGS/INGENIOUS Quaternary fault compilations missed (a) sub-meter Holocene/Late-Pleistocene scarps across active canyon-mouth alluvial fans only resolvable in 1 m LiDAR / 10 m profile curvature, (b) buried range-front and intrabasinal horst faults whose gravity/MT expressions are shifted 500-1100 m into the hanging wall away from the sub-alluvial trace, and (c) hydrothermal upflow accommodation zones marked by K/eTh adularia-illite alteration and RTP magnetite destruction rather than bedrock cliffs.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Pleistocene Lake Lahontan (~1,335 m) and Lake Bonneville wave-cut shoreline beach ridges, E-W USGS GeoDAWN airborne survey leveling seams, and partial 3DEP 1 m LiDAR tile boundaries (explicitly mitigated via Lahontan iso-elevation contour veto, spin-2 E-W flight-line veto, and IEEE NaN missing-value routing on non-LiDAR tiles).
hypotheses.falsifier: Falsified if E1_rlms_full_submodular fails to beat both its unprojected/disc-thinned ablation E3 and the reproduced same-split repository record H86F-EWCS (HOLDOUT-DTI 0.172325) with a positive paired 20 km spatial-block bootstrap 95% CI on gems57-pooled-hide-v2 (11,321 withheld positives).
hypotheses.novelty: First GEMSDOE86 lane to combine hanging-wall down-dip -> footwall up-dip spatial back-projection of gravity/MT/throw fields, branch-cut-free spin-2 nematic multi-physics director phase-locking + Riedel relay obliquity, NaN-routed 1 m 3DEP LiDAR + 10 m fluvial chi + GeoDAWN K/eTh metasomatism, 80/20 buffered-component OOF PU calibration, and exact Minoux lazy-greedy submodular 300 m triangular-kernel allocation at fixed 37,654-dot budget.
hypotheses.expected_holdout_potential: Highest directional potential in the H86I queue: targets numerator TP_w directly via sub-kernel footwall alignment, sub-pixel micro-scarp resolution, 80/20 OOF density calibration, and exact 300 m triangular-kernel submodular crest packing at matched 37,654-dot mass.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Medium (~20 minutes wall-clock on 2 vCPUs, <750 MB peak RSS via float16 memmap streaming; zero new network downloads beyond SHA-pinned .cache/external/ rasters).

hypotheses.title: Conjugate Horsetail & Transfer-Zone Damage Dilatancy via Tensorial Strain-Rate Eigen-Decomposition
hypotheses.physical_signature: Decomposes horizontal GPS strain rates into principal eigenvalues (eps1, eps2) = 0.5*Band8 +/- Band7 and kinematic transtensional regime angle phi_kin = atan2(Band8, 2*Band7) to separate Walker Lane dextral wrench transfer zones from pure Basin-and-Range normal extension, gating horsetail splay and accommodation-zone brecciation where microseismic swarm productivity (Bands 10, 16) coincides with positive volumetric opening (eps1 > 0, eps2 < 0) and deep MT fluid interconnectivity (Band 17).
hypotheses.why_blind_not_mapped: Walker Lane / Basin-and-Range transfer zones and horsetail terminations partition slip across dozens of sub-millimeter/yr buried strands across valley floors without building discrete range-front scarps, yet host ~22% of blind Great Basin geothermal systems (Faulds & Hinz 2015).
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Broad 25-40 km GPS station interpolation lobes and mining dewatering or geothermal reinjection induced microseismicity.
hypotheses.falsifier: Falsified if standalone or incremental HOLDOUT-DTI over scalar strain invariants has a 95% paired spatial-block bootstrap CI overlapping or below zero.
hypotheses.novelty: Prior WVB and EWCS lanes used only scalar sqrt(shear * dilat) without principal eigenvalue regime angle phi_kin or wrench-to-extensional horsetail termination gating.
hypotheses.expected_holdout_potential: Moderate positive complementary lift inside transtensional accommodation corridors, bounded standalone by the ~20 km spatial wavelength of GPS strain-rate grids.

hypotheses.title: Paleohydrologic Boiling-Zone Sinter/Travertine & Shallow 2-m Thermal Plume Up-Hydraulic-Head Inversion

external_pinned_sources.official_source: DOE Geothermal Data Repository (GDR) Submission 1391: 3,800 shallow 2-m temperature probes (Coolbaugh/Sladek GBCGE)
DOE Geothermal Data Repository (GDR) Submission 1391: 726 paleo-geothermal sinter, travertine & tufa deposits

hypotheses.physical_signature: Inverts advective Peclet-number shallow groundwater outflow plumes: buoyant hydrothermal fluids exit blind fault conduits at the water table and flow laterally down hydraulic head (-grad smoothed topography), displacing shallow 2-m thermal anomalies and carbonate/silica spring aprons 0.5-3 km down-slope of the blind feeder fault; anisotropic up-head Wiener back-projection coupled with RTP magnetite-destruction troughs (Band 2) and MT clay caps (Band 17) recovers the linear feeder structure.
hypotheses.why_blind_not_mapped: Hydrothermal silica/carbonate self-sealing cements and armors blind feeder faults (e.g., Bradys, Desert Peak, McGinness Hills) under Quaternary alluvium while only displaced lateral outflow plumes reach the surface.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Long-distance lateral thermal outflow confined in permeable Quaternary basalt or paleochannel gravels, and wave-precipitated pluvial Lake Lahontan shoreline tufa towers.
hypotheses.falsifier: Falsified if up-head Peclet back-projection fails to outperform symmetric radial thermal/sinter halos on gems57-pooled-hide-v2.
hypotheses.novelty: CTHB used isotropic radial spring/sinter proximity halos (which placed dots on displaced outflow aprons rather than up-head feeder faults); H86H-BPTG proposed elastic plate biharmonic flexure rather than hydraulic-head Peclet plume inversion.
hypotheses.expected_holdout_potential: High precision inside active/paleo hydrothermal districts (~10% of footprint), lower footprint-wide recall on cold blind Quaternary faults.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Medium (~45 minutes including point-survey spatial sampling bias correction).

hypotheses.title: Spectral Cordell Compaction-Stripped Intrabasinal Horst & Detachment Step Inversion
hypotheses.physical_signature: Fits a multi-exponential Cordell (1973) sediment-compaction gravity law to Band 15 depth_to_base_surf and strips the smooth basin-fill compaction bowl from Band 13 iso_grav_anom, isolating short-wavelength (100-500 m) residual horizontal gravity gradient ridges over dense Paleozoic/Mesozoic intrabasinal horst blocks beneath zero-relief playas.
hypotheses.why_blind_not_mapped: Intrabasinal horst-bounding faults beneath active evaporite playas (e.g., Carson Sink, Dixie Valley, Salt Wells) have <0.2 deg surface slope and rapid seasonal sedimentation that completely erases geomorphic scarps.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Unfaulted buried Mesozoic plutons, dense Miocene basaltic sills interbedded in basin fill, and sparse gravity station interpolation artifacts across unroaded playas.
hypotheses.falsifier: Falsified if compaction-stripped residual gradients fail to improve sub-playa (slope < 1 deg) hidden-fault recovery over raw Band 5 iso_grav_anom_slope.
hypotheses.novelty: GFCO used wavenumber upward continuation and GZZD used source-free Laplace vertical curvature; neither inverted the non-linear Cordell sediment-compaction density-depth relation against Band 15.
hypotheses.expected_holdout_potential: Moderate standalone gain concentrated in flat basin interiors (<1 deg slope).
